10x-exp-the-weakest-dragon-devours-them-:
He died being a hero. The world’s response was apparently to throw him into the body of a dragon and call it even.
Ren never got the chance to ask why he had to die saving a kid who wasn’t his. He just remembers the screech of tires, the shove, and then nothing.
What he gets instead is a goddess wrapped in light, two glowing orbs, and a choice most souls never get to make.
He picks Dragon. Obviously.
For his attribute, he reaches for whatever the universe decides to give him, no haggling, no overthinking it.
[Attribute Selected: 10x EXP]
Everyone else in this world levels the normal way, slow, grinding, painful. Ren levels at ten times that speed, devouring growth like it’s the only thing keeping him alive, because in a world full of monsters that would happily eat a baby dragon for breakfast, it probably is.
He’s not strong yet. He’s not even close. He’s small, weak, and exactly the kind of easy meal every predator in this forest is currently sizing up.
Give him time.
Give him EXP.
Watch what happens.
The weakest dragon in the world is about to become the reason every other monster in it learns to run.

the-side-character-who-wins-by-doing-not:
Lu Sangjiu spent over a year imprinting the innocent image of herself—often coughing up blood, delicate, and frail—into the hearts of everyone in the Seven Emotions Sect.
In reality, the frequent coughing of blood was real, but she wasn't actually that delicate and frail.
In the beginning, she had only one purpose for coming to the Seven Emotions Sect: to strip away the female lead Ye Zhiyao's destiny and break free from the shackles of the Heavenly Dao!
Later, looking at the simple and kind-hearted fools of her sect, she thought to herself, since it's convenient anyway, I might as well save who I can!
As the saying goes, the only thing that can defeat a pure white lotus is a refreshing little green tea.

And so...…
